correctness.rationale: At the predator-free equilibrium xbar=r/a, u=0, prey perturbations have stable eigenvalue -r and predator linearization is autonomous because derivatives of its x-dependent coefficients are multiplied by equilibrium u=0. Along characteristics its renewal eigenmodes give F(lambda,g)=∫ Bbar(τ) exp(-∫_0^τ m0(s)ds -g*xbar*A(τ)-lambda*τ)dτ=1. The real positive mode exists iff R_P(g)=F(0,g)>1; for R_P(g)<1 a complex root with Re lambda≥0 contradicts |F|≤R_P(g). For the source's smooth positive juvenile indicator A(τ)>0 at all positive ages, so R_P is strictly decreasing and tends to 0 by dominated convergence, provided R_P(0)<∞ and positive-age births. It follows that one positive g_c exists iff R_P(0)>1. The displayed derivative lambda'(g)<0 follows from implicit differentiation if the age moment exists. Source finite-lifespan simulation avoids indefinite-tail spectral subtleties. These are local invasion claims, not global nonlinear extinction or general semigroup stability without tails.
